tokens: vertui.WordPress.2026-06-11.xml (Elementor Default Kit #8, page and template _elementor_data)
assets: Canva: Vertui Main Website Hero Images pages 2, 4, 6 (DAHWetgDE_U)

tokens.name: jadestone
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Jadestone'. The Vertui teal: header CTA fill, form submit fill, form field underline, card titles, links. White text on it is 2.99:1, which only passes for text 24px+ or bold 19px+; the source sets 13px labels on it.

tokens.name: new-green
tokens.usage: Kit name 'New Green'. Near-twin of jadestone used for heading accents and Vigor Spray Max. Prefer jadestone in new work.

tokens.name: midsummer-field
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Midsummer Field'. Start stop of the primary button gradient. White text on it is 2.04:1 (fails); blue-lobelia on it is 6.24:1.

tokens.name: poisonous-ice-cream
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Poisonous Ice Cream'. End stop of the primary button gradient; accent words in hero headlines on dark photography; Root Ignite Bio accent. Reads 8.78:1 on blue-lobelia, never as text on white (1.45:1).

tokens.name: new-yellow
tokens.usage: Kit name 'New Yellow'. 2px border of the primary pill button; Hydro Balance Pro accent.

tokens.name: patrinia
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Patrinia'. Pale lime used at low alpha as a section wash (see patrinia-wash).

tokens.name: patrinia-wash
tokens.usage: Patrinia at 11% alpha: the background of alternating home-page sections, over white.

tokens.name: spinnaker
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Spinnaker'. Pale teal tint for decorative fills.

tokens.name: crystal-rapids
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Crystal Rapids'. Pale mint tint for decorative fills.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Mid green in the ring mark (lower-right arc), sampled from the Canva logo file. Logo and decorative use only; white text on it fails contrast.

tokens.name: logo-deep-teal
tokens.usage: Shadowed teal where the arcs overlap in the ring mark, sampled from the Canva logo file. Logo and decorative use only.

tokens.name: blue-lobelia
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Blue Lobelia'. The ink: body copy, product taglines, card descriptions on white (12.74:1) and on mist (12.19:1); dark grounds for white text.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page and card background; text on photography and on blue-lobelia.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Off-white section and card background, second most used surface after white.

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Light grey panel background.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Elementor 'Text' system colour; secondary text. 4.29:1 on white, so keep it to 18px+ or use blue-lobelia.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Start stop of the hover gradient (284deg, sun to sky) on every pill button.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: End stop of the hover gradient; white text on it is 4.04:1.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Legacy outline pill button text and border (11px uppercase 'Learn More' on product cards). 3.04:1 on white, fails at 11px.

tokens.name: product-root-ignite-bio
tokens.usage: Accent for Root Ignite Bio ('Product Overview' label, bottle band). Same value as poisonous-ice-cream.

tokens.name: product-soil-vitality-max
tokens.usage: Accent for Soil Vitality Max. 4.08:1 on white: headings only.

tokens.name: product-hydro-balance-pro
tokens.usage: Accent for Hydro Balance Pro. Same value as new-yellow; never as text on white.

tokens.name: product-canopy-care-elite
tokens.usage: Accent for Canopy Care Elite. 3.13:1 on white: headings only.

tokens.name: product-vigor-spray-max
tokens.usage: Accent for Vigor Spray Max. Same value as new-green.

tokens.name: product-crop-aid-myco-spora
tokens.usage: Accent for Crop Aid Myco Spora 10x. 3.56:1 on white: headings only.

tokens.name: product-crop-aid-grey
tokens.usage: Kit name 'Crop Aid Grey'. Dark earth tone on Crop Aid Myco Spora 10x packaging and pages.
